doc_name: Materials for Industry – Derek Birchall Award
text: The Materials for Industry – Derek Birchall Award is given every two years to an individual who has made an outstanding contribution to the application of materials chemistry in industry. The recipient is selected by an independent committee composed of experts from both the Materials Chemistry Division (MCD) and industry. The award is administered by the Royal Society of Chemistry and comes with a monetary prize of £2000. The award was established in 2008 to honor the work of British inventor and materials chemist Derek Birchall, who was born in 1930. The award was discontinued in 2020.
